hypothesis: CRYPTO SIGNALS HUB market-entry signals executed exactly as written (every listed target with an even split, the stated stop, 14-day cap) beat the same bracket on the same coin at other times, once signals posted after a run of at least 1% in the signal's direction over the 30 minutes before publication are skipped.

study.status: post-hoc rule chosen among 70 cells of a retrospective study of surviving posts; this ledger is its first independent test. The unfiltered book is kept to measure whether the filter itself adds anything.

source.channel: CRYPTO SIGNALS HUB (private broadcast channel, Telegram channel id 2095234574, no public preview)
source.access: the user's existing independent Telethon session (docs/TELEGRAM_AGENT_HANDOFF.md), read-only get_messages after the last seen id; never joins, sends, downloads media or touches other dialogs
source.authorization: user request of 2026-10-30 in the Claude session that built this ledger: forward paper ledger for this channel only
source.poll: every 30 s while the shared reader.lock is free; a busy lock skips that poll (no forced unlock, no second session)
source.receipt: first time a message id is returned; the first received text is frozen and later edits are never read back
source.edit_rule: an edit visible at first receipt is allowed only if it was made within 600 s of publication (as in the study)
source.clock: local clock checked against Binance server time at most 10 minutes before the receipt: |offset| <= 2 s with a round trip <= 10 s

rules.copied_from: scripts/research_kol_execution.py at commit 399fcba (parse_hub, classify, Plan, Engine, build_plan)
rules.eligible: parse_hub returns a signal with entry 'OPEN MARKET PRICE' (market) and completeness full_bracket or targets_without_stop
rules.symbol: ticker -> Binance USD-M USDT perpetual (plain, then 1000- and 1000000-prefixed) with status TRADING in an exchangeInfo snapshot no older than 6 hours
rules.units: frozen build_plan: thousands written as decimals are rescaled; a stop may also be off by one zero; a target already passed at the fill price makes the signal stale (not traded)

filter.name: skip_runup_1pct
filter.pre_move: side x (open of the 1m bar at the publication minute / open of the 1m bar 30 minutes earlier - 1)
filter.rule: pre_move >= 0.01 -> not in the primary book
filter.unavailable: a missing pre-move bar leaves the signal out of the primary book (recorded), never assumed to pass

execution.decision: freeze = the cycle that first parses the receipt; it must commit within 600 s of first receipt
execution.entry: market order at the open of the first official 1m bar starting at or after the freeze
execution.targets: even split over all listed targets; the last target closes the remainder
execution.stop: stated stop as stop-market (gap -> bar open); none stated -> none
execution.unlevered: position = notional; an unlevered short is wiped out (-100%) if the price doubles
execution.bars: official 1m for the first 2 hours, 5m afterwards; a 5m bar touching both a target and the stop is replayed on 1m; still ambiguous -> stop first
execution.cost: 10 bps per side on every fill
execution.funding: actual settlements from latest-N fundingRate reads (no time window); unproven coverage leaves net_with_funding unavailable, never zero
execution.leverage_book: descriptive only: same trade at the stated minimum leverage, isolated, liquidation at 1/L - 0.5% forfeiting the margin
execution.overlap: within each book, a signal on a coin whose earlier position in that book is still open at the new entry is recorded as skipped

books.primary: filtered: eligible, on-time, clock-verified signals that pass skip_runup_1pct
books.secondary: all: the same signals without the filter (measures the filter's own value)

control.null: same coin, same relative bracket, official 1h klines, 58 hourly starts every 12 h from entry + 1 day (post window, the study's primary baseline); price-only and 20 bps round trip for both sides of the comparison
control.signal_on_same_engine: the signal re-run on the same 1h engine starting at the hour on or after its entry
control.secondary_null: 58 starts every 12 h from entry - 30 days (pre window); descriptive

primary_statistic: mean over primary-book events with a control of (signal_1h - null_post_mean)

sample.power: about 80% one-sided at 5% for +1.0 pp at sd 5.0 pp (the in-sample effect is expected to shrink; +1.42 pp would need 77)
sample.futility_rule: if the mean primary excess of the first 80 controlled events is <= 0 the ledger stops taking new events

pass_rule: weekly block bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound of the mean primary excess > 0
mean primary-book net (1m/5m execution, with funding where proven) > 0
mean primary excess without the single best event > 0
mean primary-book price-only net at double cost (20 bps per side) > 0
integrity: protocol, ledger module and frozen rules module are SHA-256 pinned at activation and in every journal record; any change stops the journal (start v2 instead). Records only; no account or order endpoint is ever called.
